articles.title: BSF Issues ₹49.3 Lakh Tender for Drone Simulation and Maintenance Facility in Bengaluru
articles.description: The proposed facility will incorporate computer-based drone simulation systems, virtual reality equipment and associated training infrastructure. articles.title: India plans its largest strategic oil reserve in Odisha at Rs 8,571 crore cost, adding 4 million tonnes of storage as Strait of Hormuz disruptions expose supply risks
articles.description: The project is estimated to cost Rs 8,571 crore. The proposed facility at Chandikhol will have the capacity to hold four million tonnes (MT) of crude oil, expanding the country’s existing strategic storage capacity by 80%. The government is offering financial support of up to Rs 5,142 crore for the project. According to the tender documents, the contract will go to the bidder that seeks the lowest grant.

articles.title: Overpriced X-ray machines, Rs 300-crore kickbacks: ACB exposes Rs 842-cr Delhi health scam
articles.description: The ACB alleged that tender conditions were tailored to favour the selected firms and discourage competing bidders.
